title: Three Evenings and One Short Letter
subtitle: 情感心理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）
meta: 主题语境：情感心理（人与自我·做人与做事·情绪与心理）　|　核心词汇：passion　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 passion 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the counsellor ① showed the passion that no listener in the garden would have measured, and he said the showing was the whole of the evening. The ② passion, meaning the feeling itself and not the letter, ran three evenings and stayed unmeasured in the book; passion, he said, is the only thing in a garden that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ bit of passion in that garden had the same short letter beside it, and the ④ passion at the far bench, meaning the secret they kept for the children to tell and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Passion, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the counsellor said the measuring is the part that fills three evenings.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the passion was the whole of the matter, meaning the fire and not the feeling. The ⑥ passion, meaning the fire and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; passion, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both feeling and a fire. He said the fire is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ passion had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short letter. The ⑧ passion of the whole thing, the counsellor wrote in June, was one garden and three evenings of measuring; passion, he said, is either the secret at the far bench or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ passion I remember is the passion measured in the journal, which closed in 1978 and is still measured as the quietest in the garden. ⑩ Passion, my mother said in 1980, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all passion, she said, is a fire that has agreed to look like feeling. She said the fire was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 热情；酷爱（指小园里每一分旁边的那一分）
B. n. 热情；酷爱（指那份热情本身，与薄薄的信相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the passion 倾注这一份热情
D. n. 热情；酷爱（指留给孩子们说出的那一个）
E. n. 热情之事（抽象总称，指一处小园的热情之事）
F. n. 热情；酷爱（指心记里写到、被测量的那一份）
G. n. 热情、热忱（指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 热忱（抽象总称，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the passion that no listener in the garden would have measured
The passion, meaning the feeling itself and not the letter
Every bit of passion in that garden
the passion at the far bench
the passion was the whole of the matter
the passion had become a line in a journal
The passion of the whole thing

answers.why: show the passion 意为“倾注这一份热情”，1971 年那位谈心人把小园里没有一位倾听者肯测量的一份热情做了一遍。
passion 意为“热情；酷爱”，指那份热情本身而不是薄薄的信，它经过了三个黄昏而在簿子上没有被测量。
passion 意为“热情；酷爱”，指小园里每一分旁边的那一分，每一分旁边都有同一封薄薄的信。
passion 意为“热情；酷爱”，指最远那张长椅的留给孩子们说出的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
passion 意为“热情、热忱”，指一件事里人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份热忱就是那件事的全部。
passion 意为“热忱”，指人人都叹却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份热情，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
passion 意为“热情；酷爱”，指心记里写到、被测量的那一份，到 1976 年这一份成了心记里的一行。
passion 意为“热情之事”，谈心人六月写道，整件事的热情之事是一处小园和三个黄昏的测量。
passion 意为“热情；酷爱”，我记得的是心记里测量过的那一份，1978 年说尽了，至今仍被说成小园里最安静的一份。
passion 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，热情是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的热情。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
